purpose: Replace only HousePlant with a successful actual GaWF End state whose unchanged End-action Grad-CAM overlaps recognizable green leaves; all other published examples are retained. This is a selected illustration, not a localization benchmark.

HousePlant.reason: Actual autonomous successful terminal RGB includes recognizable plant pot and leaves; the warm GaWF map covers the leaves without changing normalization or gradients.

comparison: Same HousePlant validation episode and initial pose; baseline keeps its previous successful pose-replayed terminal view. GaWF uses its own saved successful RGB, prior state and policy feedback from action seed9/simulator seed1009. Different terminal RGB/history does not isolate a recurrent-core causal effect.
inference_boundary: Poses and visibility labels used only by evaluator; model sees RGB/category and its own state.
